scope: The two uuencoding originals are assigned to this port. Four shar/unshar selections exercise commands outside the assigned set. Source review is not execution.

inputs.review: Finite private file encoding/decoding. uutest-1 round-trips the supplied traditional fixture; uudecode-2 round-trips six encoded filenames via base64. Explicit encoder/decoder overrides select immutable binaries. The latter uses Bash for its ERR trap. No external paths written.
